title: Kamado Pokemon Card Denboku 066/067 U Battle Region Japanese Reverse Holo 2022
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokémon TCG card featuring Denboku from the Battle Region set released in 2022. This particular card is in Japanese language and has a reverse holo design, making it a desirable collectible for fans of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. With its unique attributes and rarity, this card would be a valuable addition to any collector's deck.
